children: Overview
UK investment manager's H1 FY27 AUM/I grew 15.5% to £28.0bln
Net inflows for H1 FY27 were below company's guidance due to increased consolidation activity
Mortgage completions rose to £10.0bln despite challenging economic conditions
Outlook
Tatton Asset Management reiterates H2 FY27 net inflows guidance of £200 mln to £250 mln per month
Company says full-year expectations remain unchanged
Tatton Asset Management expects to reach £30 bln AUM/I target ahead of FY29
Result Drivers
INVESTMENT PERFORMANCE - Co said positive investment performance contributed £2.415bln to AUM growth
CONSOLIDATION ACTIVITY - Co said increased consolidation activity in Q2 reduced net inflows below guidance
NEW IFA SUPPORT - Co said growth in adviser support helped drive business expansion
